name: Ms. B
source:
Pronouns: She/Her

The gloomy librarian of Aether West Academy. She mistakes Nova for someone else at first.

[spoiler]It turns out that she's actually Nova's mother. The reason for her gloominess was that Nova's dad broke up with her despite their relationship seemingly being perfect at the time.[/spoiler]
